title: CV
text:
Estacion Biologica de Donana (CSIC), Spain 2022–present
Research focused on plant-pollinator interaction networks, ecological networks, climate change, and biodiversity conservation. Current projects include phenological shifts in Mediterranean communities, land-use gradients and pollinator networks, and the development of European-scale probabilistic interaction networks.
Expected thesis completion: January 2027.







Estacion Biologica de Donana (CSIC) 2022–present



Imperial College London 2020–2021
Research projects:

Meta-analysis in eco-phylogenetics.
Effects of temperature on wild bumblebee body size over the past century.




Universidad de Vigo 2015–2019
Bachelor thesis: Impacts of the invasive plant Arctotheca calendula on plant-herbivore interaction networks.



Université Savoie Mont Blanc 2017–2018







Research Internship with Prof. Timothée Poisot 2023
Three-month research stay focused on mathematical algorithms for predicting plant-pollinator interactions using ecological network approaches and Julia.



Scientific Communication and Illustration 2020
Development of educational materials and videos about pollinator conservation within the CleanAtlantic project.






Winner, 3 Minute Thesis Competition, Universidad de Sevilla (2024)
Finalist, Illustraciencia X (2023)
Best Poster Award, EMAPi Conference (2019)
Academic Excellence Award, Universidad de Vigo (2016)







President (2018–2020)
Led science outreach initiatives and public engagement activities.



Organizer (2019–2022)
Co-founded and coordinated the Spanish phase of the International Junior Science Olympiad.



Volunteer (2015–present)
Support in logistics, organization and exam preparation.
